name: ELEGOO NEPTUNE 4 Pro
pre_gcode: M140 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: need to heat the bed
M190 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: wait for bed temperature
M220 S100 ;Set the feed speed to 100%
M221 S100 ;Set the flow rate to 100%
M190 S{bed_temp} ;Wait for the bed to reach print temp
M109 S{temp} ;Wait for extruder to reach print temp
G1 X67.5 Y0 Z0.4 F300 ;Move to start position
G1 X167.5 E30 F400 ;Draw the first line
G1 Z0.6 F120.0 ;Move to side a little
post_gcode: G1 E-2 Z0.2 F2400 ;Retract and raise Z
M84 X Y E ;Disable all steppers but Z
